SELECT lot_id AS lotId, location_id AS locationId, SUM(delta) AS quantity FROM ( SELECT lot_id, to_location_id AS location_id, SUM(quantity) AS delta FROM inventory_movement WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND to_location_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id = #{itemId} GROUP BY lot_id, to_location_id
UNION ALL
SELECT lot_id, from_location_id AS location_id, SUM(-quantity) AS delta FROM inventory_movement WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND from_location_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id = #{itemId} GROUP BY lot_id, from_location_id ) AS combined GROUP BY lot_id, location_id
